title: Void Generator
description: Adds a block that generates items.
body:
Hello!
This is my first mod, so you might experience some bugs.
It adds a simple-to-craft block that generates an item every minute — out of nothing!

You can configure which items it generates in the config files.
Currently, there’s only one generator, which produces one item per minute.
Placing two of them in the same chunk will overload the generator… and may have explosive consequences 💥

I made this mod to provide an easy way to get resources in modpacks that require a lot of them — or for when you just don’t have the time to gather everything yourself.
